channel.title: Lanie: Faith, Tech & Advocacy - Writing
channel.description: Working at the intersection of faith, technology, and disability advocacy.

item.title: Blind, Multiply Disabled, and Pushed Beyond Capacity: A Personal Narrative
item.description: A personal account of my experiences as a blind, multiply disabled student in a residential school setting, highlighting systemic failures and their long-term impact on health, functioning, and safety.
item.dc:creator: Lanie

item.title: The Value of Self-Paced Education for Learners with Multiple Disabilities
item.description: An in-depth essay exploring the challenges faced by multiply disabled learners in traditional education settings, and how self-paced education provides a more accessible and flexible alternative.
item.dc:creator: Lanie
item.category: accessibility, neurodivergent, blindness, chronic-illness, education, advocacy

item.title: What It's Like Gaming as a Blind, Neurodivergent, Chronically Ill Woman
item.description: A personal reflection on the barriers and joys of gaming with multiple disabilities, focusing on why text-first, untimed systems are essential for my access.
item.dc:creator: Lanie
